title: ...set up a new home Wi-Fi router
desc: Secure your local network and optimize wireless performance.
todos: Change default admin username and password on router portal immediately.
Update network SSID name to avoid identifying personal or address information.
Enable WPA3 security encryption (or WPA2-Personal minimum).
Set up an isolated Guest Wi-Fi network for IoT and visitor devices.
Enable automatic firmware update checks in router settings.

title: ...optimize a wired Ethernet connection
desc: Maximize throughput and minimize latency for gaming and streaming.
todos: Use Cat6 or Cat6a cabling for gigabit speeds and shielding against interference.
Update network adapter drivers directly from motherboard or card manufacturer.
Disable Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) in Windows Device Manager properties.
Configure network adapter speed and duplex settings to Auto-Negotiation.
Set custom high-speed DNS servers (such as Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 or Google 8.8.8.8).

title: ...unbox a new Steam Deck or handheld gaming PC
desc: Get your portable gaming rig optimized and protected out of the box.
todos: Run complete system software update while connected to wall charger.
Format microSD card to ext4/system format inside device system settings.
Configure Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator for full account protection.
Set up custom power performance limits (TDP) for intensive AAA games.
Install Proton GE compatibility layer via desktop mode for unverified titles.

title: ...configure Steam on a new PC
desc: Optimize game downloads, cloud saves, and security on desktop.
todos: Enable Steam Guard Two-Factor Authentication via phone app.
Verify Steam Cloud Save synchronization is globally active in settings.
Select optimal local download region to maximize gigabit download bandwidth.
Configure secondary hard drive or SSD library installation folders.
Enable In-Game FPS Counter and Overlay preferences.

title: ...set up a brand new iPhone
desc: Migrate data smoothly while locking down essential privacy controls.
todos: Use Quick Start proximity migration while keeping both phones plugged in.
Set up Face ID and configure Stolen Device Protection in settings.
Enable iCloud Backup and verify Messages and Photos are syncing.
Review App Tracking Transparency and set all app permission prompts to Ask.
Enable Find My iPhone including network offline location tracking.

title: ...set up a brand new Android phone
desc: Transfer data cleanly and optimize battery and privacy preferences.
todos: Transfer accounts and media using official cable-to-cable setup wizard.
Update all system apps immediately via Google Play Store updates.
Set up biometric fingerprint unlock along with a secure backup PIN.
Disable personalized ads and usage diagnostics under Google Account settings.
Turn on Android Find My Device and enable offline location network features.

title: ...un-box a brand new computer
desc: Clean up bloatware and secure your operating system on day one.
todos: Run system update utility until no OS updates remain.
Uninstall pre-installed OEM bloatware and trial antivirus software.
Enable BitLocker or FileVault full-disk encryption.
Create a non-administrator daily user account for regular web browsing.
Set up automatic system recovery restore points and external backup target.

title: ...harden your computer privacy and security
desc: Minimize data tracking, telemetry, and vulnerability vectors.
todos: Install open-source content blocker (uBlock Origin) in browser.
Disable OS background telemetry, diagnostic tracking, and location services.
Switch default browser search engine to privacy-focused service (DuckDuckGo/Brave).
Audit and revoke unnecessary camera and microphone app permissions.
Configure DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) inside web browser security settings.

title: ...prepare for an international flight
desc: Ensure smooth border clearance, document readiness, and stress-free transit.
todos: Verify passport validity extends at least 6 months past planned return date.
Check destination visa and digital entry form requirements (e.g., ETIAS/ESTA).
Notify credit card companies and bank of international travel dates.
Download offline maps and translation language packs to your smartphone.
Pack physical printed copies of key travel documents and emergency contacts.

title: ...land in a foreign country where you don't speak the language
desc: Navigate customs, transit, and connectivity safely upon arrival.
todos: Connect to official airport Wi-Fi or activate an international eSIM/data plan.
Withdraw a small amount of local currency from an official airport bank ATM.
Confirm local transit options or use verified ride-share/official airport taxis.
Save hotel address written in the local native language on your phone.
Keep passport, entry customs declaration forms, and valuables in secured daypack.

title: ...walk into a new hotel room
desc: Ensure your room is secure, sanitary, and functional before unpacking.
todos: Inspect mattress seams, headboard corners, and sheets for bedbug signs.
Verify main door deadbolt, secondary latch, and peep-hole function properly.
Locate emergency fire exit stairwells relative to your floor room location.
Sanitize high-touch items like TV remote, door handles, and light switches.
Test air conditioning, hot water, and electronic room safe lock operation.

title: ...prep your vehicle for a major road trip
desc: Prevent highway breakdowns and ensure passenger safety before long drives.
todos: Check tire pressure (including spare) and verify adequate tread depth.
Inspect engine oil, coolant, brake fluid, and windshield washer levels.
Test headlights, brake lights, turn signals, and windshield wipers.
Pack emergency kit with jumper cables, flashlight, first aid, and water.
Confirm roadside assistance coverage details and save hotline number.

title: ...breeze through airport security checkpoint lines
desc: Minimize wait times and avoid unnecessary bag searches or delays.
todos: Place liquids/gels under 3.4oz (100ml) in a clear 1-quart zip bag in outer pocket.
Keep boarding pass and physical photo ID accessible until through screening.
Remove heavy jackets, belts, metal items, and empty pockets into bins.
Pack large electronics (laptops/tablets) so they can be removed quickly.
Wear easy-to-remove slip-on shoes if you do not have TSA PreCheck/Global Entry.

title: ...stay in a shared hostel room for the first time
desc: Keep your personal items safe while being a courteous room occupant.
todos: Secure passport, wallet, and electronics inside locker using your own padlock.
Pack a small shower bag and flip-flops for shared bathroom facilities.
Keep headlamp or phone light low when entering dorm rooms late at night.
Identify accessible power outlets near your bunk for overnight device charging.
Store luggage neatly under your bed space to keep common walkways clear.

title: ...check out of an Airbnb or vacation rental
desc: Avoid unexpected cleaning fee disputes and ensure nothing is left behind.
todos: Conduct a thorough room-by-room sweep under beds and outlets for chargers/items.
Consolidate trash and food waste according to host house rule instructions.
Start dishwasher or run used dishes if specified in checkout checklist.
Set thermostat to target departure temperature and lock all windows and exterior doors.
Return physical keys to lockbox and message host upon departure time.

title: ...board a cruise ship on embarkation day
desc: Navigate boarding procedures, safety drills, and cabin setup smoothly.
todos: Pack essential meds, documents, and swim gear in day carry-on bag.
Complete mandatory safety muster drill steps as soon as you board.
Connect to ship network app to book specialty dining or show reservations.
Inspect cabin upon keycard access and report any pre-existing damage.
Switch mobile phone settings to Airplane Mode to avoid maritime roaming rates.

title: ...suspect someone is having a stroke
desc: Act FAST to identify critical stroke symptoms and save lives.
todos: F - Face Drooping: Ask the person to smile and check if one side droops.
A - Arm Weakness: Ask the person to raise both arms and see if one drifts downward.
S - Speech Difficulty: Ask the person to repeat a simple phrase to check for slurring.
T - Time to Call 911: Call emergency services immediately if you observe any sign.
Note the exact time symptoms first appeared to inform emergency responders.

title: ...treat a household thermal or heat burn
desc: Reduce tissue damage and prevent severe infection immediately after a burn.
todos: Cool the burn immediately under cool (not cold or ice) running water for 10–20 minutes.
Remove rings or tight items from affected area before swelling begins.
Cover burn loosely with clean, non-stick sterile gauze or plastic film wrap.
Do NOT pop blisters, apply butter, ice, or ointment to open skin.
Seek urgent medical care if burn is larger than 3 inches or on face, hands, or major joints.

title: ...respond to severe arterial or deep wound bleeding
desc: Control life-threatening blood loss before paramedics arrive.
sourceName: Stop The Bleed / American College of Surgeons
todos: Call 911 immediately and ensure scene safety before approaching.
Apply firm, continuous direct pressure to wound using clean cloth or sterile gauze.
Pack deep wounds tightly with sterile gauze or clean cloth while maintaining pressure.
Apply tourniquet 2–3 inches above wound on arm or leg if bleeding does not stop.
Keep victim calm and covered with blanket to prevent medical shock.

title: ...help a conscious adult who is choking
desc: Perform abdominal thrusts to clear obstructed airway safely.
todos: Ask 'Are you choking?' — if they cannot speak, cough, or breathe, act immediately.
Stand behind person, lean them forward slightly, and give 5 sharp back blows between shoulder blades.
Wrap arms around waist, place fist just above navel, and deliver 5 quick inward/upward abdominal thrusts.
Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until object is dislodged.
Call 911 immediately if person loses consciousness and begin CPR.

title: ...open a High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA)
desc: Maximize interest earnings while keeping your emergency fund risk-free.
todos: Verify financial institution is FDIC or NCUA insured up to $250,000 per depositor.
Compare Annual Percentage Yields (APY), monthly maintenance fees, and minimum balance rules.
Link primary checking account via secure ACH electronic bank transfer.
Set up automatic recurring monthly transfers to build emergency savings habit.
Designate official account payable-on-death beneficiaries for financial security.

title: ...freeze your credit reports against identity theft
desc: Block unauthorized loans and new credit accounts opened in your name.
todos: Create official security accounts on Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion portals.
Request a free Security Freeze on each of the 3 major credit bureau websites.
Store generated PINs or security passwords safely in a password manager.
Request a security freeze with Innovis and ChexSystems (checking account protection).
Unfreeze credit temporarily whenever applying for legitimate new loans or cards.

title: ...set up your 401(k) at a new job
desc: Capture employer matching money and automate retirement compound growth.
todos: Contribute at least enough percentage to claim 100% of employer matching contribution.
Select low-cost Target Date Index Fund or broad S&P 500 index fund options.
Choose Traditional (tax-deferred) or Roth (tax-free growth) contribution type.
Enable annual auto-escalation to increase savings rate by 1% each year.
Designate primary and secondary account beneficiaries.

title: ...build a debt elimination payoff plan
desc: Gain momentum paying off credit cards and personal loans systematically.
todos: List all outstanding debts with exact balances, minimum payments, and interest rates.
Organize list from smallest balance to largest balance (Snowball Method).
Pay minimum required payment on all accounts except smallest balance debt.
Throw all extra disposable income toward eliminating smallest debt balance.
Roll entire payment amount from paid-off debt into next smallest balance.
